call_points.text: No Nazara-level revenue, EBITDA or margin guidance for FY27.
Bluetile and BestPlay reported ₹518 Cr revenue and ₹55 Cr EBITDA in Q1FY27; consolidation expected from Q2FY27.
Raymond Stauffer, Bluetile founder-CEO, becomes Nazara CEO from 1 September 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
NODWIN targets organic growth of 30%+ for FY27 and is progressing towards IPO readiness.
Sportskeeda's Google-related challenges persist; management sees Q1 as the bottom with revenue rising through Q2-Q4.
AdTech EBITDA stays thin because pass-through revenue is 60-80% of reported topline; margin improvement tied to Vizibl.
Tax exposure from real-money gaming subsidiaries is limited to the investments, which have been fully written off.
Management expects to accelerate growth both in revenues and EBITDA in FY27, backed by real operating leverage.

timeline.summary: Nazara Technologies held an extra-ordinary general meeting on May 1, 2026 to seek shareholder approval for Section 186 loan/investment limits and preferential warrants.
Nazara Technologies reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹397.78 Cr, announced management re-designations, and withdrew the Paper Boat Apps merger scheme.
Nazara Technologies reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,829 Cr and a 66% jump in EBITDA to ₹255 Cr.
ICRA issued the monitoring agency report for Nazara Technologies reporting ₹64.96 Cr utilized out of ₹495 Cr preferential issue proceeds as of March 31, 2026.
Nazara Technologies Limited shared the audio recording link for its Q4 & FY2026 Results Analysts/Investor Conference Call held May 13, 2026, at 9:00 AM (IST).
Nazara Technologies reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,829 Cr and a 66% increase in EBITDA to ₹255 Cr during its earnings call on May 13, 2026.
Nazara Technologies announced the receipt of 1,278 Pre Series C CCPS in Rusk Media for ₹14.99 Cr, raising its stake to 7.62%.
Nazara Technologies announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary Nazara FZ LLC will invest USD 500,000 (~₹4.76 Cr) in nCore Games, Inc. via a Convertible Promissory Note.
Nazara Technologies approved the allotment of 1.82 Cr warrants at ₹260 per warrant, collecting ₹118.50 Cr upfront.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹803.15 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹36.28 Cr (against a loss of ₹29.35 Cr a year earlier).
Nazara reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹803 crore and EBITDA of ₹120 crore, driven by the consolidation of Bluetile and BestPlay.
Nazara Technologies Limited provides audio link for Q2 FY27 & H1 FY27 earnings call held on 27 Oct 2026 at 12:00 Noon IST.
